placements.theme: Organizational category holding decisions about the technical platforms, data systems, and infrastructure choices that the product and engineering org build on.

placements.title: Analytics infrastructure shifts to higher-performance, lower-cost platforms
placements.theme: The analytics pipeline's underlying database platform is replaced in favor of systems chosen for materially better query performance and lower licensing cost.
placements.why: The five expressions describe one connected account — the decision to move the analytics pipeline off PostgreSQL onto QuantumDB (src-1, src-3), the rationale of 10x query performance and lower licensing cost (src-2, src-4), and the Q3 2026 timeline for it (src-5). Per the grain test, the migration event itself and its stated performance/cost figures are facts/evidence, not a leaf in their own right; what they evidence is the recurring, future-feedable theme of this org moving core data infrastructure toward higher-performing, cheaper platforms. No existing narrative leaf was supplied to hold this (graph structure is empty), so this is a genuine mint rather than a forced reuse.
